timestamp_semantics.exec_s: REST executedAt: venue status clock, whole second (floor) of the CONFIRMED status, 0 / 1 / 10 s after Matched on own legs; the match ends before (S + 1) * 1000 (evidence); S3 assumes it is at most REST_LAG earlier
timestamp_semantics.t_ms: WS settlementsPending: the venue book clock (updateTimestampMs) of the first frame whose aggregated pending amount at the price rose by the leg's (how 1) or its cell's (how 2) value; linked by value within +-1.5 s of the Confirmed second (no signed identity)
timestamp_semantics.t_e2: E2: the venue book clock of the displayed-size drop closest to the cell volume within [S * 1000 - 600, S * 1000 + 600) - a search centred on the Confirmed second; S3 does not use it
timestamp_semantics.first_recv_ns: the collector's local receipt clock (ns) of the first REST page carrying the leg; not aligned to the venue clocks
timestamp_semantics.place / signed / accepted: the bot (kernel) clock: Control Place, Exec Signed, the Accepted answer received
timestamp_semantics.cancel confirmation: the bot (kernel) clock: CancelPendingAudit - the first HTTP Canceled answer or user-stream cancel received (an upper bound on the effect)
timestamp_semantics.fill notice: the bot (kernel) clock: the first Matched / Confirmed fill notice received
timestamp_semantics.Matched / Confirmed stamps: the venue status clock, whole seconds (the notice's match_time per status)
timestamp_semantics.replay axis: venue time in ms after the order posting; the replay treats the book, WS and REST stamps as one clock (not established)
